notes.title: SENTIENT STEEL 1.1 Update Out Now!
notes.content: [p]A few months ago I decided to take a break from my new project, [i]Morpho (working title)[/i], to return to [i]SENTIENT STEEL[/i] with fresh eyes, over a year after release. [/p][p]As a [b]thank you[/b] to those who have played, and as a personal bookend on this project, I wanted to publish a comprehensive free update to address the shortcomings that I ran out of time to fix last year.[/p][p]Over time, the scope of the update expanded, until I had eventually looked at [b]almost every element of the game[/b]. Here's a list of the key improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Significantly improved performance[/p][/*][*][p]Gameplay improvements and rebalancing[/p][/*][*][p]Overhauled visuals and interfaces[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed audio[/p][/*][*][p]120fps support[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements for Steam Deck[/p][/*][*][p]Numerous bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p]So, whether you're back to fight the infection all over again, or returning to finish it off, I hope you enjoy the updates in[i] 1.1[/i]![/p][p]Lastly, if you're new to [i]SENTIENT STEEL[/i], please consider trying the [b]free demo[/b]! It has been updated to [b]Ver. 3[/b], which includes all the improvements present in the main game.[/p][p]Thank you for all of your kind support.[/p][p]- etcher[/p]

notes.title: SENTIENT STEEL Demo Ver. 2 is out now!
notes.content:
[b]SENTIENT STEEL[/b] has changed a lot since the original Demo released. As the list of improvements grew, I realised you were all left with a largely outdated version of the Demo, so today I'm here to fix that!

[b]Ver. 2[/b] includes the first two Missions of the game: both of which have been [b]almost completely overhauled[/b], and include some brand new surprises. Unfortunately, as the structure of the game has solidified in the lead-up to release, I've had to remove the third Mission (don't worry, it's still in the final game!) I apologise for this, and hope that the two reworked Missions will suffice until February.

You'll also find [b]improved visuals[/b], [b]improved UI[/b], requested features such as [b]adjustable music and SFX volume[/b], and, of course, [b]many, many bug fixes[/b].

Thank you for your continued support. SENTIENT STEEL is coming soon!

- etcher

notes.title: SENTIENT STEEL Demo is available now!
notes.content:
A huge thank you to those who have already downloaded and played the SENTIENT STEEL Demo!

If you haven't had a chance to try it yet, you can look forward to:

[list]
[*] 3 fast-paced Missions, playable in day or night mode
[*] Sliding, wall-running, and rail-grinding in and around Machine growths 
[*] Destroying powerful Machines with close- and long-range combat
[*] Full controller compatibility (but plays great with a keyboard!)
[*] All of the above playable solo or co-op
[/list]
Thank you for all of your support so far, I'm going to get back to work to make the final game as good as it can be!

- etcher
